summary: This plugin adds image-understanding and OCR capability to DeepSeek Harness text-only models by exposing tools such as describe_image and extract_text for generating descriptions and extracting text from images or documents.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The repository’s primary user-facing purpose is to add media understanding to a text-only chat/agent workflow: it provides tools for describing images and extracting text by forwarding requests to configurable OpenAI-compatible vision/OCR endpoints. Evidence in README and package metadata shows this is a DSH web plugin that additionally adds attachment handling UX (paste/send flow and previews) and reliability settings such as preprocessing, retries, and caching.
